components.summary: Installs or checks the packaged skill and verifies portable public vocabulary.

components.summary: Dispatches current-tree commands and reports progress toward one target.
responsibilities: parse command lines and dispatch to map, proof and template commands; keep scan project ignores untouched and print one empty-model release summary; contract template setup names COMPONENTS and PARENT; export read --mermaid, optionally focused by component; release rejects uncovered contract invariants while map models only warns; show each scoped cycle or layer violation once as an ARCH line in change; include the built-in system root in release declared/executed counts; models --tests runs bound tests and release always checks their individual implementation reach; non-strict check and change annotate only planned breakage, report static target work without running target models, and release warns about a target while checking only the strict current tree; keep the ui-flow capability template entrypoint as the same native ui-journey factory while retiring the old ui-flow-structure template name; keep the contract-exhaustion capability template command as the same validator factory; after normal release checks and bound tests pass, optionally invoke the exact whole-suite shard tool once, keeping normal TESTED_BY execution separate from within-suite exactness; template writes model files into the active target when present, preserving other output paths and force semantics and naming target check as the next step

show the existing owner of a behavior and the component that defines an exact symbol, with files, state and side effects (read --find) and owning model ids; read --target shows static node changes and supports component details or Mermaid, while --find remains a separate mode
direct retired workflow flags and legacy project detection to references/upgrade.md while preserving their rejection status
side_effects: writes .flowguard/map.json on scan, deps --write and confirm

components.summary: Lazily exposes native model-tree and computation APIs, with upgrade guidance for retired names.
responsibilities: expose current public names from their owning modules without importing those modules early
direct retired public API names to references/upgrade.md without changing public name resolution

components.summary: Generates ordinary behaviour, validator and UI journey models plus adoption rules.
responsibilities: generate the behaviour, validator and ui-journey node starters plus six adoption rules; before changing behaviour or structure use a target and extend the existing owner
UI journey and validator placeholder code and test anchors fail cleanly until filled; behaviour has sample shop code and a commented test binding that callers replace with their real code and tests

components.summary: Release tool: collect exact pytest IDs, run bounded parallel shards and derive complete native execution outcomes.
responsibilities: shard tests by exact node id; every shard runs on every invocation; the optional release whole-suite phase uses the same native shard runner and verifies each collected test ran exactly once within that suite
retain typed capability blockers and bounded process cleanup results
side_effects: runs pytest shards; writes run-local cache

components.summary: Inventories files, symbols, imports and duplicate bodies.
responsibilities: inventory files, symbols and imports, including literal import calls; share quiet closed-output-pipe handling across CLI entries; allow explicit read-only inventory without cache directory creation or writes, keeping the normal cache default
parse explicit bound-test item selectors as pure strings for TESTED_BY validation and execution

components.summary: Owns map schema, model bindings and component fingerprints.
responsibilities: validate, load and save the map, writing depends_on sorted and deduplicated; read, validate and merge the one target map as a pure overlay without changing the current tree; resolve one complete optional model view with canonical paths and explicit missing mappings, retaining ordinary registry behavior by default; validate explicit entrypoint, state and side-effect removal intents against the current map without deleting extra content; register only contract models and report each leftover legacy runner location once as a runner_model migration error, including in a target view
compute component fingerprints that detect stale descriptions

read model literals (MODEL_ID, PARENT, COMPONENTS, IMPLEMENTED_BY, TESTED_BY, NOT_MODELED) without importing the model; recognize the optional project_parent_state hook; retain retired design-marker literals solely to diagnose misplaced current models
count strings as dependency evidence only in import-like contexts

build the model tree: PARENT, default parents and model imports; nesting mistakes are errors; derive each model's components from COMPONENTS, anchor owners and home; distinguish root home from a component named system; warn when a model's bound test file is outside every component's test patterns; a child import of its explicit model parent does not invert the tree, while impact keeps the real import edge; only in a target view, keep a missing child anchor inside a component parent when its declared files match that path, while ordinary current, model-parent and unmatched-path containment keep their errors
treat an unknown PARENT, a PARENT loop, parent_import_mismatch, child_outside_parent and duplicate_child_owner as errors; keep test_not_nested and child_start_gap as warnings
resolve imports through removed model paths supplied by impact without registering historical models as executable nodes

components.summary: Discovers entrypoints, effects and reachable calls.
responsibilities: discover entrypoints, side effects and state writers; propagate an explicit no-cache-write mode without creating cache directories
del statements count as state writes; expose exact anchor state writes for model checks

components.summary: Checks ownership, reviews architecture and selects checks.
responsibilities: verify the map against code; name the owners next to an unmapped file; every contract model declares IMPLEMENTED_BY anchors that resolve and conformance(); unbuilt behavior belongs in target models; report model-tree nesting warnings; every model's components come from COMPONENTS, anchors and PARENT, with unrelated map listings warned and ignored for selection; check and lint share one structural rule set (cycles, layer violations) and show the shortest import path; share type-separated responsibility, state and side-effect duplicate-owner rules with the root model; warn when unanchored code writes state that a model covers, honoring global anchors and explicit negative scope; accept an explicit merged model view without changing checks on the ordinary current tree; validate optional exact TESTED_BY parameter selectors against their base test symbol without changing other anchor kinds; count selected test items once by their base function in the component tests facet; report each legacy runner location as an error with its contract-model migration path; never register it for execution

impact selection (depends_on order is irrelevant): retain surviving current and historical tests/models; select contract models by their anchored files and TESTED_BY tests; block missing or ambiguous test commands; select no checks for comment-only edits after normalizing physical newlines; retain the full closure for unchanged and newline-only requests; a changed existing model or model helper also selects every importing model and every ancestor model, without adding their tests; name owning models in REVIEW and impact JSON; expand explicit importing review children of selected model parents to a fixed point; ignore target draft paths before impact analysis, and filter replaced model suggestions without dropping selected tests

recognize real Git-removed contracts through the canonical static registry; omit missing retired paths only when current references are gone, preserve surviving parents, importers and their tests, and select same-id replacement paths
review architecture; a cycle debt covers its member set, and a grown cycle stays an error; group more than three unlisted entrypoints per owner and strength without changing severity

rank behavior owners, prioritizing exact symbol definitions; show one system/component/model tree and its Mermaid equivalent; derive purpose, rules, known-bad, code and test facets from static source and map facts without importing user models; count real test functions and subtree bindings, marking nonnested and untested bindings; own the shared structural rules and source-filtered known-bad generator; name an existing target or its invalid-map warning in the current tree header without running checks; compare current and merged target facets from their selected physical model source, show additions, changes and removed-node tombstones with stable identities, and share the same text budget and five-facet details
compare current owner promises with merged target owners and explicit removal intent when checking a target
one owner per entrypoint; external promises are modeled or explained; warn about the retired behavior ledger without reading it
side_effects: reads git history; refreshes disposable analysis cache

components.summary: Keeps one target and checks its merged tree against actual code and tests.
responsibilities: start, extend and drop one target without executing models or code checks; reject a retired design marker in a current model as an error while preserving the existing target marker rejection

check the current tree with the target applied using native static checks and fresh model proofs with bound tests; separate design errors from code and test work; write no project files or caches; keep entrypoint_owner findings as design errors; keep independently missing implementation anchors as code to-do when target-declared component containment is valid, with genuine regression coverage for the current and invalid-parent boundaries; retain runner_model retirement errors as errors rather than code to-do
identify exact current component, model and flow findings covered by the target; preserve unplanned failures and expose the same static target checks without model execution

promote a target after one complete check and unchanged checked inputs, writing its prepared map and model bytes, leaving changed components draft, and reporting partial I/O failures without automatic recovery
stop a target that silently drops an entrypoint, state or side effect
show invariant_untested as a model warning while retaining proof and known-bad failures
side_effects: writes current .flowguard/map.json and .flowguard/models/ only after a clean target check

components.summary: Runs model proofs, precise placeholder failures, individual bound-test reach and native architecture rules with ordinary result messages.
responsibilities: run models and their known-bad and conformance checks; warn about every invariant that no known-bad variant violates; load sibling model imports from the model directory; derive component model hints from the contract-model tree; release fails on them; check a child's start states only when it declares project_parent_state, without lending parent-check calls to child anchors; report the actual design invariant and known-bad variant names without rerunning proof hooks, abbreviating only their text display; run models on the current tree with the target applied in one temporary model namespace with canonical filenames, selected sibling sources and finally restoration; keep default proof judgments and tag actual code gaps for target classification; print computed hazards for every model after its existing design exploration, never gating a verdict or repeating user hooks

fail a contract model whose IMPLEMENTED_BY anchors are missing, unresolved or never consulted (called or read); give conformance a static code-facts reader (anchors, words, imports of or references to a symbol outside its own file) and load the code an anchor names
own bounded subprocess cleanup shared by models and pytest shards; nested POSIX helpers share one session

run the built-in root model 'system' using the shared static architecture rules and known-bad generator from map analysis, with map check as conformance; reject shared state or side-effect ownership through that same architecture rule owner

run each model's TESTED_BY tests under the anchor watch; each bound test and parameter case must pass and call or explicitly read at least one implementation anchor in its own call window; name the rules that no bound test guards; run explicitly selected bound parameter items without weakening per-item code reach
check real code facts and keep failed facts visible; place models of unbuilt behavior in the target
return optional per-test statuses from the existing bound-test execution and report exact placeholder anchor failures without a traceback
side_effects: runs one isolated pytest process per model when bound-test checking is requested

check liveness and progress

components.summary: Checks named scenarios and minimizes counterexamples.
responsibilities: review scenarios against expected outcomes
minimise counterexamples

collect first-seen projected initial and retained trace step states for a parent-child port

responsibilities: benchmark the engine on a problem corpus

responsibilities: define function blocks, workflows and traces
compose a sequence of blocks or a choice of blocks by accepted input type

components.summary: UI journeys as a model kind: states, controls and transitions explored, checked against the UI source
responsibilities: check actual UI states, controls, displays and transitions, including failure recovery, destructive primary actions, usable dialog exits and declared-state reachability without mandatory rationale or plan text

explore control journeys using the same structural reviewer and compare declared control identifiers and handler anchors with real UI source through existing code facts; manual rendering, geometry and keyboard checks remain outside those static facts

components.summary: Validators as a model kind: a finite input boundary, generated bad cases, each executed against the real function
responsibilities: generate complete finite bad cases and bounded Cartesian interactions with stable case identifiers and a real oracle for every case; reject invalid, unbounded, missing-oracle or excessive boundaries directly instead of returning partial coverage

execute every allowed generated bad-case feature combination against the real function, preserving clean-call observations and naming any accepted bad case; mutation labels do not establish arbitrary temporal side-effect behavior

flows.summary: an AI session reads the map
check the map and list what to run after editing code
run models with known-bad and conformance checks
